decisions.decision: Use Mastra TS over LangGraph / CrewAI for Phase 1 Orchestrator
decisions.reason: TypeScript native alignment with Next.js & Supabase stack, Vercel zero-config deployment.
decisions.tradeOffs: Mastra TS is newer than LangGraph, but provides zero context switching for Next.js stack.

decisions.decision: Adopt 5 Enterprise Governance Pillars (Registries, Knowledge Graph, Plugins, Observability, 10-Tier Stack)
decisions.reason: Transforms AI-OS from a prompt script into a maintainable, enterprise-grade AI operating platform.
decisions.tradeOffs: Slightly more initial registry structure, but 10x higher long-term scalability and self-learning.
